title: noUsernames
description: NoUsernames removes all player name tags above heads with zero setup and zero performance impact. Just install and play.
body:
# NoUsernames — Full Anonymity on Your Server

**NoUsernames** is a lightweight plugin for Minecraft servers (Paper/Spigot) that completely hides player usernames above their heads. Create an atmosphere of anonymity and mystery on your server!

---

## 📋 Features

- **Username Hiding** — player names disappear from above their heads, making the server more immersive
- **Full Compatibility** — works with Paper, Spigot, and any forks on versions 1.16.5+
- **Zero Overhead** — the plugin is optimized and has no impact on server performance
- **Simple Installation** — just drop the .jar into the plugins folder and restart the server
- **Automatic Operation** — no configuration or setup required
- **Compatibility** — works alongside any other plugins without interfering with their functionality

---

## 🎯 Why Use This?

- **PvP Servers** — hide opponent names for fairer battles
- **Streamers** — avoid showing other players' names on stream
- **Roleplay Servers** — full immersion without distracting nameplates
- **Minigames** — conceal information about opponents
- **Anonymous Servers** — create a mysterious, enigmatic atmosphere

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Download the latest version of the plugin
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server (or use `/reload`)
4. Done! All usernames are now automatically hidden

---

## 📌 Commands & Permissions

The plugin requires no commands or permissions — it works "out of the box."

---

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can I bring the names back?**
**A:** Yes, simply remove the plugin from the plugins folder and restart the server — names will be restored.

**Q: Does the plugin show up in /plugins?**
**A:** Yes, the plugin appears in the plugin list.

**Q: Do I need to configure anything?**
**A:** No, the plugin is fully ready to use right after installation.

**Q: Does it affect performance?**
**A:** No, the plugin is lightweight and does not put any strain on the server.
